title: Neodustria Phase 23.2 Blinded Scientific Discovery & Active Falsification Ledger
phenomenon_investigated: Residual Parasitic Lateral Drift in Symmetrically Folded Compliant Shuttles

blinded_hypothesis_formulation.muse_initial_hypothesis: Residual lateral drift dx in symmetric folded multi-stage flexures scales quadratically with stroke dy due to incomplete cancellation of geometric foreshortening, and inversely with blade thickness th due to increased lateral stiffness resisting parasitic motion.

active_falsification_cycle.falsification_outcome: FALSIFIED_AND_REVISED (Discrepancy exceeded initial tolerance; prompted quantitative model revision)
active_falsification_cycle.muse_revised_analysis: Initial model predicted dx=4.8877mm vs measured 0.7059mm (error 4.18mm) because it assumed uncancelled linear-exponential lateral coupling. Data shows dx/dy^2 ~0.0085 constant across all 5 points (0.00855, 0.00848, 0.00844, 0.00848, 0.00850), proving pure quadratic foreshortening dy^2 with folded shuttle cancellation, not linear drift. Thickness dependence vanishes.

scientific_insight_verdict: VERIFIED (Meta Muse formulated an independent power-law relationship, actively diagnosed prediction error upon FEA feedback, and revised parameters to improve generalization from 0.0381mm to 0.0094mm RMSE, beating Classical Random DoE)
